div.head: ECf 7
div.ab: De reddendis decimis sancte ecclesie. De omni annona decima garba sancte ecclesie reddenda est.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 631 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.
Liebermann’s upright (roman) letter a after “decimis” refers to his explanatory notes, the Erklärungen (printed as Gesetze III; his note on p. 627 calls it “Band II”), which are not yet added here.
